title: Stable phase retrieval for sine series
question: Which infinite frequency sets $\Lambda\subseteq\{1,2,\ldots\}$ give stable phase retrieval in the real closed sine span in $L^2[0,1]$, and how dense can they be?
summary: Three questions ask whether a fixed lacunary gap gives a uniform stability constant, whether a stable spectrum can have growth exponent greater than $1/3$, and whether stability forces an $L^p$ bound for some $p>2$. A supplied baseline construction already gives polynomial density of exponent $1/5$. The common obstruction is the existence of two unit sine series concentrated on nearly disjoint sets.
